structured.answer: I never got my own numbers: the "עצמאים" button wouldn't switch, so all the calculator showed was the employee example (₪300 a month from me + ₪900 from an employer). That gives "52,334" kept after 4 years (with "המסלקח −10,661" tax) and "137,649" after 8 years (tax 0). Most of that is employer money I won't have as self-employed, so I can't use those figures.

stuck.why: I tapped 'עצמאים' 4 times, by name and by position, and after scrolling so the top bar wasn't over it. It stayed on 'שכירים' with the checkmark. Without it I can't get a self-employed calculation.
They ask for 'הפקדת המעסיק, מהשכר' and 'משכורת ברוטו'. As self-employed I don't know what to put there, and with the toggle stuck I couldn't see what fields self-employed people would get.

used: Bar chart labels 'הפקדתם', 'המעסיק הוסיף', 'התשואה הוסיפה', 'המס לקח', 'נשאר בידיים' with the numbers on top
Line 'קרן השתלמות במסלול מדד. 300 ₪ בחודש מכם, 900 ₪ מהמעסיק'
Labels 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' / 'מ־6 שנים: פטור ממס'
skimmed: Top heading and subheading, 'מה זה' paragraph (6 years tax free)
skipped: Rest of the page below the bar chart
Input fields (salary, %, return, fees). I left them as they were
unsure_meaning: Whether the 52,334 at 4 years is after tax (there's a −10,661 and a pink striped box)
Dotted underlines on the numbers, and '123 מחושב' vs '123 ממקור' at the top
not_found: A working self-employed version of the calculator
A field for just my own monthly amount, with no salary %

findings.what: The 'עצמאים' button does nothing when tapped. It stays on שכירים, so a self-employed person can't use the calculator at all
findings.where: Calculator toggle at the top of 'כמה כסף נשאר לכם, ומתי?'

findings.what: The big result number mostly comes from the employer's money (+86,400 of 137,649), so for me it's misleading. I'd have walked away thinking I'd get that much
The sticky tab bar at the top covers the toggle when you scroll down, so I wasn't sure if I was hitting the button
findings.where: Sticky chips 'מה זה / מה קורה לכסף בקרן' over the calculator

findings.what: The tax shows as a minus number with a hatched pink box. Scary, and it wasn't obvious whether it's already taken off the final number
